This intervention is UNVERIFIED and requires the specified field test to confirm efficacy.

PARAMETER: Condenser tube internal configuration — Twisted-tape inserts or wire-wound geometry to enhance turbulence — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Minimum Reynolds number target — 15,000 to maintain turbulent flow and reduce boundary layer thickness — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Pressure drop allowance — Max 2.0 psid increase at 100% flow to avoid significant head loss — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Installation window duration — 40 hours per chiller, staggered to fit within annual 48-hour limit — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Baseline thermal resistance — Derived from 14 days of healthy chiller data pre-installation to establish R_baseline — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Target capacity restoration — 8% increase in cooling capacity at peak load — ASSUMPTION
PARAMETER: Target efficiency improvement — 15% reduction in kW/ton at peak load — ASSUMPTION

The proposed mechanism involves installing flow straighteners or replacing straight tubes with twisted-tape or wire-wound inserts in the condenser heat exchanger of the 2 x 1,200-ton water-cooled chiller plant. This increases internal turbulence and reduces boundary layer thickness, which prevents scale nucleation by maintaining supersaturation below the critical precipitation threshold, thereby reducing thermal resistance due to scaling. This intervention respects the fixed water treatment chemistry by not altering chemical dosing or provider-managed parameters, and it respects the 48-hour annual shutdown window by scheduling the physical tube replacement or insert installation within that limit, split across the two chillers. Supporting data does not directly support specific thermal or hydraulic performance values for twisted-tape inserts in this chiller context, so all parameter values are engineering assumptions based on standard heat exchanger design principles.

Falsification test:
Test temperature: 35 C cooling water inlet temperature
Duration: 4 weeks of continuous operation post-installation
Sample size n: 2 chillers
Pass/fail criteria: kW/ton at peak load decreases by 10% or more relative to pre-installation baseline, AND condensing temperature at rated load decreases by 2.0 C or more relative to baseline. If either criterion is not met, the intervention fails to restore the expected efficiency.
